messages.subject: Distance design run not responding
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to set up a point transect for a large area of California =
split into 3 strata. I believe I have everything set up correctly in =
Distance but when I click "run" on the Design tab, Distance says it is =
running survey 1 and the pointer becomes an hourglass but the program =
gets stuck in this stage. After a few minutes the task manager shows =
that Distance is not responding. I'm not sure what is causing this. Is =
it possible my shapefile is too large (it's 10,062 KB)? Anyone else =
having this problem or know how to fix it?

Thanks,
Scott
